results.title: Carry On Jatta 4
results.overview: A romantic deception spirals into household chaos when a family must construct an elaborate web of lies to conceal a secret relationship.

results.title: Dastaar
results.overview: A Sikh immigrant rises from newcomer to community leader following a devastating racist attack.

results.title: Tera Mera Ki Rishta
results.overview: Meet, an adventurous young man from Vancouver, travels to India with his mother to attend a wedding. While he falls for Rajjo, a small-town girl, his mother arranges his marriage with someone else.

results.title: Hashar - A Love Story
results.overview: Hashar is the story of today’s young generation who without true feelings of love, get together and later due to misunderstandings their life becomes tumultuous.Set in university campus it highlights the fact that when supported by politicians for their own benefits, student politics can take an ugly turn and create havoc in the personal life of students.The story is all about love, passion, hatred and romance and above all this fiction is more than reality.

results.title: Singh vs Kaur 2
results.overview: Singh vs Kaur 2 is an upcoming Indian Punjabi-language romantic comedy film directed by Navaniat Singh and produced by Gippy Grewal's Humble Motion Pictures and SVF Entertainment. Serving as a standalone sequel to the 2013 film Singh vs Kaur, it stars Gippy Grewal and Shehnaaz Gill, scheduled for worldwide release on 11 September 2026.

results.title: The Legend of Maula Jatt
results.overview: Maula Jatt, a fierce prizefighter with a tortured past seeks vengeance against his arch nemesis Noori Natt, the most feared warrior in the land of Punjab.

results.title: Ishqa'n De Lekhe
results.overview: Starring the sensational Gurnam Bhullar alongside the stunning Isha Malviya, this Punjabi cinema is crafted for every soul that has ever loved deeply. Directed by the talented Manvir Brar, Ishqa'n De Lekhe is set to redefine Punjabi romance on the big screen.

results.title: Shera
results.overview: A high-energy action drama centered on strength, loyalty, and confrontation. The story unfolds through intense moments and gripping action as the protagonist faces powerful forces and personal challenges.

results.title: Jind Jaan
results.overview: While on a trip to Thailand, Ranjha, a young musician is entrusted with the task of teaching music to Juliet, the heiress of a rich family. The two soon develop a connection, but will their differences and circumstances come in the way of their relationship?

results.title: The Great Punjab Robbery
results.overview: Three robbers with strange names seize an ordinary bank in Punjab. No demands. No ransom. Just cryptic riddles sent to the cops, each one leading deeper into the mystery.

results.title: Eh Din Roz Ni Aune
results.overview: In a fortunate encounter, carefree 25-year-old Prabh meets Aavraj, a practical, successful 55-year-old businessman. Their contrasting ideologies create a fun-filled office family drama.

results.title: Asees
results.overview: At the heart of Asees is the story of an endearing mother-son duo. Through their journey, the film paints a poignant portrait of the powerful bond between a mother and her child.

results.title: Birds in the Dark
results.overview: A police informant Jagtar takes Amir, a Muslim man from Kashmir, into custody. As they travel through the jungle and the mountains towards the bustling city, Jagtar eventually sets Amir free and returns to the hometown he once fled. There, as agricultural workers begin to organize a struggle, Jagtar reunites with Raman, a landowner and his former lover. Meanwhile, Amir comes to the town looking for Jagtar and meets Dilraj, the leader of the workers' organization, and begins to feel a sense of solidarity.

results.title: Rehmat
results.overview: Three interconnected stories in present-day Punjab. A woman secretly shelters a wounded stranger within her home, while his family endures the weight of grief and impossible choices. Meanwhile, a mysterious elderly man arrives in a village, calling himself God.

results.title: Thana Sadar
results.overview: A man hides from the world by committing a crime, but nature is always a witness to a crime.

results.title: Mitti De Putt
results.overview: Two villages are bound by a rivalry that has outlived the men who started it. For one young man, the feud stops being history the day his uncle murders his grandparents and carries his mother away. Left with nothing but the land beneath his feet and the promise he makes on it, he sets out to answer blood with blood. To bring his mother home, he must first confront the man who took her, and the price the soil demands is heavier than he knows.

results.title: Chal Mera Putt 2
results.overview: A tale of everlasting love between illegal immigrants struggling for their PR in the UK as they challenge they multiple struggles.
